controller_6m.notes: Quote verbatim on p242 ('(B) Undertakings by the Largest Group of Shareholders', Rule 10.07(1)). The clause states an explicit end date: 'in the period commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of his shareholding in the Company is made in this prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date'. The period ends ON 2026-10-21 (last restricted day); first free day is 2026-10-22. Candidate recorded the anniversary as first_free_day - corrected.

corrections.basis: Rule 10.07(1) undertaking by each member of the Largest Group of Shareholders: period ends ON the date which is six months from the Listing Date (2026-10-21); the stated end date is the last restricted day, so first_free_day = anniversary + 1
